name: turbo
description: Makes Claude Code faster, smarter and safer in any project: an indexed code MCP server (repo map, exact file outlines, symbol jumps, folded reads of huge files, ripgrep search, syntax checks), hooks that verify every edit and re-verify at stop, guards against large-file rewrites and destructive commands, a short session briefing with continuity from the last session, plus skills and subagents for orienting, surgical patching, debugging, verification, smoke testing and handoff.

brief.title: Session brief
brief.description: Inject a short project briefing at session start: stack and check commands, large files with embedded blobs, what the last session left behind, the handoff note.

stop_check.title: Stop-time re-check
stop_check.description: Before Claude ends a turn, re-verify every file edited in the session (capped at 12 seconds) and keep it working if something is syntactically broken.

guard_level.title: Guard level
guard_level.description: One of: strict (deny catastrophic shell commands, ask before risky ones and before large-file rewrites), deny-only (only deny catastrophic commands, never ask), off (no command or write guards). Anything else counts as strict.
